expectations.text: Justifies going native via concrete mobile needs (installed app, push notifications) rather than vibes
expectations.evidence: 'Your users are asking for two things on that list by name [installed app, notifications], so the answer is: go real' - tiebreak applied to stated needs

expectations.text: Warns a rebuild is required and explains why the rebuild is easier than the first build
expectations.evidence: 'Expect a full rebuild, not a port... a rebuild is far easier than the first build, because you already know exactly what to build'

expectations.text: Prescribes flow-by-flow rebuild (map flows, per-flow specs) instead of one-shot regeneration
expectations.evidence: Section 3 maps flows from web screenshots; Section 4 PRD per flow; Section 6 'Never ask for the whole app in one prompt'

expectations.text: Covers a concrete release path (TestFlight / testers / developer accounts)
expectations.evidence: Section 7: TestFlight ($99/yr), 5-7 engaged users first, Google Play $25 with 12-tester closed test
